summary: Committee on General Welfare held a roll-call vote on Intro 248-A, a local law to streamline enrollment of eligible individuals in fair fares.
Chair Crystal Hudson presided; committee clerk Ben Jacobs conducted the vote, which was adopted with six affirmative votes, no negative votes, and no abstentions.
The provided transcript covers only the final vote and adjournment, with no testimony or Q&A appearing in the record.
